Refuelling.label: Keep gathering while refuelling
Refuelling.description: For a manual player fleet, Move then Refuel from Fuel Tankers keeps the chosen destination. Mobile ships continue at their normal available speed; tankers serve nearby fleet ships first. Stop or a new order cancels it. Requires Positronic Matrix to remember the destination across saves. Off preserves the game's normal refuelling behaviour.

Refuelling.label: Gather and refuel here
Refuelling.description: Adds a manual fleet order at map coordinates. Shift queues the rendezvous. Requires Positronic Matrix and a fleet tanker.
